current_behavior: The canonical alpha POA&M is an 82-line, 52,359-byte Markdown record whose 27 deficiencies are encoded as one-line seven-column table rows. The longest row, POAM-011, is 10,599 characters. Deficiency observations, impacts, gate mappings, closure evidence, lifecycle statuses, status vocabulary, milestone discipline, and two item-specific updates share one file, so an agent cannot load or link one clean deficiency record.
target_behavior: Keep docs/poam/rrflow-1.0-alpha.md as the sole canonical remediation-status coordinate and turn its body into metadata plus linked warp headings and a compact 27-row ID/priority/status/record ledger. Add a classified nested portal, one governance chapter for ownership/status vocabulary/milestone discipline, and exactly one coordinated detail record for each POAM-001 through POAM-027 under docs/poam/rrflow-1.0-alpha/. Move each original observed-deficiency, impact, owning-gates, and closure-evidence cell verbatim into its item record; move the existing POAM-011 convergence update and POAM-027 execution decision into their respective records. Each detail record delegates priority and lifecycle status to the canonical parent. Add one discovery link from docs/poam/README.md and preserve every original deficiency fact, priority, status, mapping, evidence requirement, date, revision, digest, and limitation without semantic change.
